title: A debt close reads the PR's own CI result for the suite its Retire line names, so `merge --ready` does not run hooks/test_guard.py a second time
why:
Ask (consultant 15:00 CST, relayed by the coordinator 15:07; not built; triage read no code): the debt-close lint runs hooks/test_guard.py, about 39 min (measured once), inside `merge --ready`, and then the PR's CI runs the same suite. Rule roles-each-layer-proves-once: CI is the merge check, each layer proves a change once. Design point (coordinator): `--ready` runs before the PR's own CI run exists, so reading CI needs a different place for the check, or another source, such as the draft touched-tests run. Kin: ready-step-hang-no-timeout (the heartbeat only; the family selector is parked there), ready-checks-time-bound. A change that moves a refusal to a pass on weaker evidence is a widening: it is not built without a `Departs from:` line to the coordinator, and an owner question if it widens. First act of a lane: read lint/check_debt_retire.py judge_close, name which run a close can read and when it exists, then propose; red then green only after the coordinator picks. OWNER WORDS 15:11 CST Nov 14 (consultant, owner 15:06 CST Nov 14, verbatim, relayed by the coordinator 15:09; a question in chat, not an answer to a page item): "if the test runs on the machine abd it covers everything ci will the it shd skip ci right (whatever maximized speed via cutting repetition)". Consultant's design reading (unmeasured; not the owner's words): one proof per tree per OS, in whichever place is fastest. For the debt-close check that place is CI (sharded, no queue block): move it after the PR's ready run and read that run's result, so the local 39-min run goes. A local run replaces a CI job only when it posts a status bound to the exact tree and OS (degen's native-check poster is the pattern). RULE CHECK (triage): no filed ruling covers this. Rule roles-each-layer-proves-once says each layer proves a change once, and ruling push-skip-proven-tree skips a push run on a proven tree; neither covers a local run replacing a CI job. R37 (no fixed limits) is about word counts, not this. So it is the owner's direction in chat, not yet a ruling: it becomes one when he answers a page question on the design. STATE 20:20 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 20:19, data; triage read none): the coordinator started lane debt-close-reads-ci. First act: read judge_close and send the coordinator a one-line route choice. Design point stays: a close that cannot read CI stays refused. LANE 20:31 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 20:29): lane debt-close-reads-ci is session_013NEJKyvDFUWUG59sK2f6Dx. The coordinator said 20:19 it set this step to doing; the record read status todo when triage filed this, and triage left the status alone. DOING 20:32 CST Nov 14 (triage): set to doing. The lane session reads live (get_session at 20:31: status idle, bucket blocked, post-turn summary need_input, "pick --ready behaviour: defer (recommended) or keep the local run"; its connection_status reads disconnected). The coordinator started the lane 20:19 CST; first act reads judge_close and sends a one-line route choice; a close that cannot read CI stays refused. The lane has filed inbox items and waits on a pick between deferring the --ready check and keeping the local run (triage read neither the inbox items nor any code). PICK 21:23 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 21:20, its own, undoable, under his 15:06 chat question, 20:17 goal and 20:18 words; filed as coord-debt-close-route-a; the lane read 21:20; triage read neither #3251 nor any code): route A: rebuild on top of #3251 once it merges; `--ready` defers the debt close for a draft ("deferred to confirm: no run exists yet"); the ready PR's CI step judges every close; `confirm` refuses a missing, running, red, wrong-head or unreadable result. It changes #3251's own commit 7cd0adf3 and its test for drafts (re-pointed red then green, not deleted). Design point stays: a close that cannot read CI stays refused. The coordinator reads it as not a pass on weaker evidence at the merge, so no owner question (its reading, unverified by triage). The coordinator's pick, not the owner's. PICK 21:56 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 21:55, undoable): the route A PR goes out under slug debt-close-defers-draft, after #3251 merges. Hand-in went to runner 10 (merge.py order, after #3254); lane stopped. Round 1 gave no blocker and three notes; a note becomes a debt only after an incident, so no debt is filed. (1) lint/check_debt_retire.py:242-245: judge_close runs the deferred branch before the cite is read, so a draft preview prints BLOCKED on a delete that a cited green run would clear when the PR is ready. Preview-only, merge unaffected. The lane's preferred fix prints 'deferred to confirm' as a note; it needs a code change and a fresh round: step deferred-close-preview-note. (2) docs/decisions/debt-close-runs-retire.md:13 says a deferred close is 'neither passed nor refused here' and then that the --fast-checks debt row reads pass: reword to one claim (doc wording fix; no step). (3) merge/merge.py:3993 and actions/stamp/README.md:376 still say each closed debt runs a Retire test; on a draft none runs (doc wording fix; no step). 00:35 CST Nov 15 (read by REST): notes PR #3453 (seven limits left by the Retire run moving into CI, PR 3251) is an open draft, head 4c1200fb4ffd, and is a member of docs combine #3458 (head e49d068b129e, open draft, with runner 10).
